profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Roku Inc.
profile.summary:
Enjoyed working at embedded software 

- Architect on STB development
- experience in developing S/W in +20M devices in the CE market 
- experience in designed Smart TV like HTML5 app based ecosystem
- experience in developing extremely reliable/robust S/W system like weapon.
- Expert in Linux system, embedded system with C / C++
- Architect in Network programming, VOD streaming as well as DRM
- Getting more knowledge in server side architect and mobile development(iOS, Android)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintain the Roku OS platform by fixing bug and adding new features

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Design new IP STB stack and keep catching up with new tech and apply on STB like RDK, Yocto, Alexa and WebPA.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Have a great time to build up the STB from the scratch. Every challenge makes me feel live and gives me an unbelievable energy.

Understanding new area, especially the headend server is a kind of finding the last piece of puzzle.

Design new architecture of STB and focus on how to deliver linear and VOD over IP.

How to connect the STB efficiently and control it conveniently and how to simplify the current complex  old systems is my another interesting future works.

positions.title: Visiting S/W Engineer at CableLabs
positions.description:
I have been dispatched to CableLabs (Denver) since 2012.
During working at CableLabs, I knew more Cable industry and the future of home network environment.

- Contribute on CVP-2 (VidiPath) and have a lot of IOT with MVPD.
- Help MVPD (Comcast, TWC, ...) to launch their App on Samsung Smart TV

positions.title: Principal S/W Engineer of Smart TV
positions.description:
* Launch the Netflix, Verizon, Telstra, Maxdome, Pandora, Blockbuster, Cinemanow, Vudu, Hulu ...
* In charge of PVOD service under Samsung Smart TV. 
* In charge of Device API of Samsung Smart TV.
* Porting Widevine (Google) Adaptive streaming and DRM to BD Player (Linux OS)
* Porting WMDRM to BD Player (Linux OS)
* Netflix, Blockbuster, YouTube, Pandora service launch on Samsung BD Player from 2008.
* Develop HDMI, HDMI-CEC S/W module

positions.title: Senior S/W Engineer
positions.description: develop the guidance control SW for missile.
